title: C3 Policy-as-Code Compliance Framework — Reproducibility Artifact
description: Reproducibility artifact for the paper 'Policy-as-Code Compliance Framework for PCI DSS and NIS2 in Kubernetes Environments (C3)' (Computers & Security, manuscript COSE-D-26-03044). Includes Terraform EKS infrastructure, OPA Gatekeeper and Conftest Rego policy libraries mapped to PCI DSS and NIS2 controls, a deterministic synthetic dataset generator (2,200-manifest corpus plus an 18-case adversarial supplement), evaluation scripts for every experimental phase (admission detection accuracy, fail-open/fail-closed latency comparison, audit drift-detection latency, CI overhead), and the raw measurement results underlying the paper's tables.
